privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: SmartBreeds keeps only what it needs to work: your email address, your password (stored hashed, never readable), the pets you save (name, species, breed, age, weight, health needs). Your language choice stays in your browser.
privacy.p2: Photos you analyze travel over an encrypted connection, are processed to recognise the animal and are then discarded: they are not stored. To write the report the photo is processed by an AI model, which may be a hosted service (Mistral AI) acting on our behalf.
privacy.p3: We use only two technical cookies, needed to keep you signed in. No advertising, no tracking, no third-party analytics. Our servers keep technical logs (IP address, requested page, time) for security and troubleshooting; they are deleted after a limited time.
privacy.p4: You can change your data from Profile and My pets at any time. Deleting your account permanently erases it together with every pet linked to it.
privacy.p5: SmartBreeds is a student project built at 42. For any question about your data, contact the project team.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: SmartBreeds helps you discover your pet's breed from a photo and suggests suitable food. By creating an account you accept these terms.
terms.p2: Breed and health notes are produced automatically and can be wrong. They are not veterinary advice: for any health concern, ask a veterinarian.
terms.p3: Upload only photos you have the right to use. Photos with inappropriate content are rejected.
terms.p4: Food suggestions are computed from your pet's profile and are not sponsored.
terms.p5: The service is provided as is, without any guarantee of availability. These terms may change; the current version is always on this page.
accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.p1: SmartBreeds aims to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA.
accessibility.p2: The app works with a keyboard alone and with screen readers: pages have landmarks and headings, forms announce their errors, and focus moves to the new page title when you navigate. Colours meet AA contrast in both the light and the dark theme.
accessibility.p3: You can pause every animation with the “Pause animations” button at the bottom of each page. If your system asks to reduce motion, animations start paused.
accessibility.p4: How we check: every automated interface test runs the axe-core audit for WCAG 2.1 A and AA, plus a dedicated dark-theme audit of the main pages, together with keyboard-only and 320-pixel-wide tests.
accessibility.p5: Known limits: breed names keep their usual English form, and the descriptions written by the AI model may sometimes be less clear than the rest of the interface. If something does not work for you, open an issue at https://github.com/Nihilantropy/ft_transcendence/issues.
